subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body: 4/5 — the rep was polite and explained the Wi-Fi field as a deferred onboarding step. I called the packet scanner about it anyway; they said the hold is not a routine authorization and is tied to a review already open on my account. The hold rationale is on file under the WC-12 onboarding record (same reference as my prior packet), which is the record the packet scanner reconciles against. Everything else about the thread was handled well.
